objective: Integrate the contained pinned runtime as a tool-less local Codex review provider
nonGoals: Run a model in GitHub Actions or automated tests
Change containment or structured review contracts
acceptanceCriteria: The provider constructs a bounded inert-data prompt from trusted task, diff, SHA, and deterministic evidence inputs
Every model tool, hosted search, network permission, approval path, ambient environment, and persistent session is disabled
Role-specific output schemas require code-security or QA artifacts and code review requires empty acceptance evidence
The JSONL parser accepts only allowlisted lifecycle, reasoning, and one final agent-message event while rejecting tool, error, malformed, duplicate-session, and invalid-UTF8 events
Nonzero exits and stderr fail closed with bounded secret-safe classifications rather than raw provider output
Production provider execution uses the attested runtime through SystemdCgroupExecutor
Automated provider tests use a fake executor and do not invoke a model
